name: GetCurrentUserClockedHoursState
description:
Returns the current user's clock-in state: whether they have an open worked-hours slot and, if so, which type and since when. Lightweight — no corrections or history. Populated only when ClockIn:Enabled is on for the open slot's organization unit; otherwise IsClockedIn is false and the rest are null.

The type fields report the protected default types (Regular, Break) whether or not ClockIn:TypesEnabled is on, so a client can always tell whether the user is on a break. A custom type is reported only when ClockIn:TypesEnabled is on for the slot's organization unit.
auth_description: Requires a user of type `Employee` or `Api`
